items.title: Scientists discover a hidden switch that shuts down inflammation
items.excerpt: Scientists have uncovered a natural braking system that helps the immune system switch off inflammation and prevent harmful immune cells from building up. Boosting this pathway in people reduced inflammation-related immune changes and sped up pain relief, pointing toward potential new treatments for chronic inflammatory diseases.

items.titleZh: 免疫系统如何给炎症“踩刹车”？
items.excerptZh: 研究人员发现一种自然调节机制，有助于关闭炎症并减少有害免疫细胞的积累。对这一路径的研究，可能为慢性炎症疾病提供新的治疗方向。
